title: Find a Menu Editor that works in never versions

posts.author: SakuraMiya
posts.body:
I moved my rpg game from Vx Ace to MV. When I was working for the menu, I used
a Script
that allowed me to turn the menu window for commands invisible (for a custom menu) and move it slightly with the Menu Editor function. However I realized it doesn't work on never MV updates (you need to press F12 to open it, but in newer versions it opens googledevtools instead). Do you know of a similar script that works on newer versions?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
SRD menu manager works on the up to date version of MV and updated nw.js with a few minor bugs in the movement tool if that's what you're trying to ask.
If it doesn't maybe your plugin order is off, or something else is messing with it.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
F8 is mostly dev tools, goes to F12 in newer NWJS or MV version,
and may work, SuperTool engine is set to F12, but it may be possible
you need SRD_GameUpgrade above it in order to make it work.
not sure if it was required or for other plugins, so try to add it and above
SRD_SuperToolEngine, and it should work when you press F12.
as it seems to work on my end though.
